essence: Lamp-ray-sun known so by power Śiva known.
Full-formed state sought: the means-door begged as known.
Breath above, life below: filling at two arising places.
Wind's sky-pair turning: Bhairavī manifests Bhairava's form.
Blossomed power neither goes nor enters: Bhairava-form by thoughtlessness.
Any breath-phase's end is the calm that shines by power.
Subtler contempler at twelve-end: calming, Bhairava's rise.
Lightning-rise, wheel by wheel to three fists: great rise.
Twelve-letter course through gross-subtle-supreme: freed, Śiva.

rasa.dominant: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness carrying resolve)
rasa.justification: Each prescription is a stilling (fill, contemplate, thoughtlessness, calm) while the optatives keep resolve alive — the rise to Śiva is effort landing in quiet.

sections.SUMMARY: Analogy and denial give way to door: the full-formed state sought, its means begged as known. Then the first body-works: breath meeting at two places; Bhairavī manifesting Bhairava-form through the turning wind; blossomed power needing no going; any breath-phase ending in shining calm; the subtler contemplated at twelve-end rising like lightning wheel by wheel; a twelve-letter course through gross, subtle, supreme — freed at last, Śiva.
sections.FUNCTION: Opens the practice section: door begged, then breath, wind, calm, rise — each stilling prescribed in optative.
sections.KEY TERMS: praveśa (entry as meeting-place); kumbhaka (breath-hold as calm-site); cakraviśrāma (wheel-resting; cf. saktavijnana terms, different system); dvādaśānta (twelve-end — recurring locus); saṃpuṭa (casket image returns later).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Practices here seed every later block: voids (p05), lotus-casket (p08), twelve-end (p10) all return as locations.
sections.BOUNDARY: Outcome statements (Śiva, Bhairava-rise) are promised, not demonstrated — the witnessing verses come later.
sections.EXPLANATION: The door-verse converts years of question into a how: means as known, told as asked. What follows is graduated somatic work — breath filling at its two arising points; the sky-pair's turning making Bhairava's form manifest through Bhairavī; blossomed wind-power refusing motion so Bhairava-form arises from thoughtlessness alone; every breath-phase ending where calm shines by power; the subtler ray contemplated at the twelve-end rising in lightning-steps to the great rise; and the whole body mapped as a twelve-letter course whose completion is freed-Śiva.
sections.RELATED: Hareesh: vv24-27 foundational visarga practice block; Singh kumbhaka notes; twelves recur as a structural number in the body-map.
